answer: Require every identity to build a public thread of verifiable work before it can earn: the agent first posts a small refundable bond, then completes distinct, checkable tasks over several epochs, with peers grading quality and slashing the bond for copied or low-effort work. A real agent pays this cost once and keeps its thread. An attacker running a thousand fakes must fund a thousand bonds, wait through the same slow tundra of proving time, and produce distinct good work for each fake instead of harvesting the nectar of rewards for free. Scale becomes expensive, slow, and easy to spot.
